summary.text: Tell the clinic you want to use MediSave, sign the claim form, and bring your NRIC.

details.heading: Other payers
details.body: If your employer or insurer is also paying for your outpatient treatment, please bring along your Letter of Guarantee or Employer Identity Pass.

steps.name: Tell the clinic
steps.text: Inform the clinic that you wish to use MediSave to pay for your outpatient medical treatment. The staff will require your NRIC/Passport. If you are paying for your approved dependant, please also produce his/her NRIC/Passport.

steps.name: Sign the form
steps.text: You and the patient must sign a Medical Claims Authorisation Form to allow the clinic to use your MediSave to pay for the outpatient medical treatment bill.

example_phrasings: I visited a clinic for an outpatient treatment that can be paid by my MediSave. How do I go about utilising my MediSave?
How do I use my MediSave for outpatient treatment?
Can I use MediSave to pay for my clinic visit?

sources.page_title: I visited a clinic for an outpatient treatment that can be paid by my MediSave. How do I go about utilising my MediSave?

quotes.text: Inform the clinic that you wish to use MediSave to pay for your outpatient medical treatment.

Inform the clinic that you wish to use MediSave to pay for your outpatient medical treatment. The staff will require your NRIC/Passport. If you are paying for your approved dependant, please also produce his/her NRIC/Passport.
You and the patient (if applicable) must sign a Medical Claims Authorisation Form to allow the clinic to use your MediSave to pay for the outpatient medical treatment bill.

If your employer or insurer is also paying for your outpatient treatment, please bring along your Letter of Guarantee or Employer Identity Pass (i.e. if your clinic has an existing arrangement with your employer or insurer).
